# Bid the zones, the trench, and the backflow.

> Price a new sprinkler system from zones, extra heads, trench footage, soil, controller, 3/4-inch PVB versus 1-inch versus 1.5-inch RPZ, drip conversion, rain sensor, and a master valve — not a published $400-a-zone special. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
